raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “the city that contains the basilica” as Rome/Italy rather than Vatican City (the actual city containing St. Peter’s Basilica). This led to selecting Italy’s unification in 1861 instead of Vatican City’s establishment as a sovereign state in 1929 via the Lateran Treaty. The error reflects a misclassification of the target city and an incorrect coupling of the date to Italy rather than Vatican City.
